yago-piedras-lopes.candidateEmailDraft:
Hi Yago,

Thank you for taking the time to speak with us about the Python Developer (AI Evaluation) role. We really appreciated learning about your background, including your experience at Turing and your work in AI engineering.

After the conversation, we've decided not to move forward at this time. During the technical discussion, we found some gaps between your understanding of agents and evaluation concepts and what the role requires, and a few of the technical questions didn't land the way we'd hoped. This isn't a reflection of your overall skills or potential, just a mismatch with what this specific position needs right now.

We'll keep your resume on file and would welcome hearing from you again for future opportunities. Thanks again for your time and interest.

Best,
[Your name]
